skills.name: Curse of Black Bean
skills.description: A curse you have been afflicted with since passing through Black Bean's strange portal.

skills.name: Pink Bean Power
skills.description: Pink Bean's power is practically overflowing!

skills.name: Pink Bean's Dignity
skills.description: Pink Bean's basic powers stem from being a natural-born boss monster. His awesome abilities make him totally different from regular monsters.

skills.name: Pink Powerhouse
skills.description:
Pink Bean realized using tools can be fun! Keep tapping the attack key to deal several consecutive attacks with lots of tools and move forward. You don't bump into monsters when moving forward.
Increases damage for other skills after use. Can be linked to other skills.

skills.name: Pink Powerhouse
skills.description:
Pink Bean realized using tools can be fun! Keep tapping the attack key to deal 4 consecutive attacks with lots of tools and move forward.
Increases damage for other skills after use. Can be linked to other skills.

skills.name: Let's Roll!
skills.description: Pink Bean realized rolling around is way faster than walking. Can be used on the ground and in the air. It even changes depending on where it is used. Not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Umbrella
skills.description: Pink Bean lands from the air more slowly than usual. It reminds you of something...

skills.name: Chill Out
skills.description: When Pink Bean is tired from exploring Maple World, he has many cool ways to relax. This skill produces different effects depending on the action. Not affected by buff duration increase.

skills.name: Instant Garden
skills.description: Pink Bean loves growing monstrous plants, and this is a perfect spot for one! The plant's attack is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Sky Jump
skills.description: Pink Bean loves soaring through the skies of Maple World! Not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Everybody Happy!
skills.description:
Pink Bean cheers on the whole party with his special brand of adorableness! Boosts Party EXP, Speed, Attack Power, and Magic Attack Power. However, the obtained EXP bonus is halved for any party members on different maps than the caster.
Unaffected by buff duration increases.

skills.name: Blazing Yo-yo
skills.description: Pink Bean is one of the finest yo-yo-ers of this generation! Watch this burning trick that clobbers enemies multiple times. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Pink Pulverizer
skills.description: Pink Bean's love for all things pink can be... dangerous. This knocks over a pink pillar to deal heavy damage. During cooldown, there's a chance for Mini Beans to come to your aid, and every time they attack it lowers the cooldown on this skill. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Let's Rock!
skills.description: Pink Bean is a huge music buff, and has no qualms about busting out with his instruments. Each instrument has its own special effect.

skills.name: Go, Mini Beans!
skills.description: With each attack, Pink Bean's fan club members, the Mini Beans, come out and attack alongside Pink Bean. What great groupies!

skills.name: Pink Shadow
skills.description:
Pink Bean loooves making shadow pictures, and summons a pink shadow which copies its actions after a short delay. It won't copy certain movement skills, and while it will act out summoning and buff skills, they'll have no additional effect.
Pink Bean sometimes will sometimes look back, notice the shadow, and wonder whether shadows can do that.
* The shadow's attack is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Pink Warrior
skills.description:
Jealous of a goddess's boon to her followers, Pink Bean came up with a way to temporarily increase the stats of all his party members.
This effect stacks with Maple Warrior, Call of Cygnus, Nova Warrior, President's Orders, Anima Warrior, Rhinne's Protection and Hero of El Nath. They say imitation is the highest form of flattery.

skills.name: Go, Pink Beans!
skills.description:
Pink Bean is interested in moving through portals and keeps on opening new ones to random places. Sometimes someone familiar comes out of those portals.
There are still many devoted to following Pink Bean. Still as popular as ever.
Go, Pink Beans! is not affected by attack reflection.
skills.note: hit (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Pink Bean's Tutu
skills.description:
Ballerina Pink Bean dons a tutu and gives a twirl. That's some incredible centrifugal force! Strong enough to break through rocks, even.
Can move while using. Increases Damage, attack range, and Speed when used long enough. 
Cannot be copied by Pink Shadow.

skills.name: Pink Bean's Scooter
skills.description:
Pink Bean loves zooming around on a scooter made just for him! And don't worry! It's not a battle scooter or anything, so it won't even sting if he hits you with it.
Cannot be copied by Pink Shadow.

skills.name: Twilight of Gods
skills.description:
Pink Bean has taken a keen interest in the sculptures he saw while traveling through Maple World. Now he's recreated his visit to the Temple of Time.
Look at those masterfully-crafted sculptures! Wait, why are they moving? What the... Ahhh!
Twilight of Gods ignores damage reflection.

skills.name: Pink Bean's Matryoshka
skills.description:
Attack enemies with a series of nesting dolls. Inside? None other than Pink Bean! Who knew playtime could be so deadly?!
Pink Bean's Matryoshka cannot be copied by Pink Shadow.
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Bounce
skills.description: Pink Bean can sort of double-jump now. Use this skill in mid-air to have Pink Bean jump farther.

skills.name: Pink Splitter
skills.description:
Pink Bean has grown interested in Shade's Soul Splitter, and can use it to divide one nearby enemy's soul.
The split soul explodes after 5 sec, and deals damage to nearby enemies.
Cannot be copied by Pink Shadow.
ouls will not be split for bosses and stationary monsters.
What pink friend should he create this time?

skills.name: Magic Show Time
skills.description:
Pink Bean wants to start his own magic show, so he's 'borrowed' some tools from his fellow monsters. Upon defeating an enemy using a direct attack skill or on attacking a boss, you'll receive 1 Magic Tool per attack. You must gather a certain number of Magic Tools in order to use them, however they cannot be gathered while Magic Show Time is active or on cooldown.
Magic Show Time is not affected by attack reflection and ends when you change maps.

skills.name: Triple Color Spotlight
skills.description: Everyone listen to my music! There are three different colored spotlights for Superstar Pink Bean shining bright. Since the spotlights are set up only for Pink Bean, enemies under the spotlight take damage. On the other hand, Pink Bean is protected by the power of the spotlights and stats are enhanced. Unaffected by attack reflection.
